offering_description.value: Provides lease-to-own and rent-to-own access to furniture, electronics, appliances and computers for consumers with limited access to traditional credit. Serves customers through company-operated stores, online checkout and third-party partner merchants using lease-purchase financing.

primary_products.value: furniture; consumer electronics; home appliances; computers; mattresses

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individual consumers with limited access to traditional credit, buying household goods

end_markets.value: consumer retail; household goods; consumer finance

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: lease-to-own payments on furniture, electronics and appliances; product sales: merchandise sold outright at stores and online; service fees: lease and processing fees charged to consumers
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Operates stores and online channels selling leased merchandise to consumers; financial intermediary: Provides lease-purchase financing to consumers at partner merchants

geography_served.value: US national: Stores and partner merchants across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: rent-to-own retail stores and lease-to-own financing for partner merchants

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated rent-to-own stores; online: e-commerce and online lease checkout; partners / resellers: lease-to-own checkout at third-party merchant stores

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: state lease-to-own and consumer protection laws, with CFPB oversight of consumer finance practices

notes: Business segments and geographic footprint may have changed; verify current operations.
